name: Sonnya Gray
source:
The main character. A 16 year old girl who's rather quirky and has a deep bond with her older brother, Milo. She is determined to find her brother no matter what. She has a rather dark past that she'd rather not let anyone know about.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29640]Lemma Soft Thread[/url]]
